title: Sustainable moisture-induced electricity from wood through asymmetric hygroscopic design and radiative cooling
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05073A, Paper
Chenyue Guo, Huajie Tang, Decheng Kong, Qixiang Chen, Xin Wu, Fan Fan, Xinyu Zhao, Renhao Ding, Wenqi Zhong, Dongliang Zhao
